Public Art Opportunity: Harbour District Water Works Visitor Path

Open Call · Northbay

Deadline Oct 22, 2026, 2:45 pm

**About the commission**

The Harbour District Water Works invites artists to propose a permanent public artwork for the new visitor path along the treatment ponds. The path opens in spring 2028 and will be used by schools, neighbours and walkers. The work should help people understand how water moves through the district and how it is cleaned before it returns to the bay.

**Budget**

The budget is 80,000 for design, fabrication, installation and all fees. A separate maintenance fund is held by the district.

**Eligibility**

The call is open to individual artists and artist teams living in the region or with a demonstrated connection to it. Artists at any stage of their career are welcome; experience with permanent outdoor work is helpful but not required. Teams may include designers, engineers or landscape architects, but the lead must be an artist.

**What to send**

A letter of interest of no more than one page, describing your approach to place and to working with the public. Up to ten images of past work with a short caption for each. A current CV of no more than two pages. Optional: a link to a short video of up to three minutes.

**Selection**

A panel of artists, neighbours and district staff reviews all applications and invites three finalists to develop a concept. Each finalist receives a fee of 2,000 for the concept stage, a site visit and a meeting with the engineering team. The selected artist is expected to start design work in March 2027.

**Timeline**

Applications close on 22 October 2026. Finalists are notified in late November 2026. Concept presentations take place in January 2027. Fabrication runs through 2027 and installation is planned for early 2028.

**Accessibility**

If you need the call in another format, or help with the application, write to the programme office before the deadline. Support for interpreters and for applicants with disabilities is available on request. Applications may be sent as text, audio or video.

**Questions**

An online information session is held two weeks before the deadline; a recording is shared with everyone who registers. Questions sent in writing are answered on the call page so that every applicant sees the same answers. This text is fictional test data in the shape of a real call.
